title: Testing Between the Test Cases: Proving End-to-End Steering in Conditions You Never Drove
abstract: arXiv:2609.10951v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-based automated vehicle testing is challenging because a model that passes every test condition can still fail in the real world. Formal verification offers a way to directly address this gap. On a simulated highway and an arterial road we trained two small end-to-end steering networks each in CARLA, one on clear conditions alone and one on clear, fog, night and low sun. All four models were driven against a 2.19 ft lane-departure budget. Without driving again, we used bound propagation, a formal method that reads the trained weights, to compute how far steering can drift at every disturbance strength between two captured images. One calculation covers more than a campaign could drive: on the arterial it spans 133 poses, where ten intensities each would be 10^133 combinations, in minutes on one GPU. translated_title: 在测试用例之间进行测试：在从未驾驶过的条件下证明端到端转向性能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.10951v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于AI的自动驾驶车辆测试具有挑战性，因为一个通过所有测试条件的模型在现实世界中仍可能失败。形式化验证提供了一种直接弥合这一差距的方法。在模拟的高速公路和城市干道上，我们在CARLA中分别训练了两个小型端到端转向网络，一个仅在清晰条件下训练，另一个在清晰、雾天、夜间和低太阳光条件下训练。所有四个模型均以2.19英尺的车道偏离预算作为约束。无需再次驾驶，我们使用边界传播（一种读取训练后权重的形式化方法）来计算在两个捕获图像之间的每个扰动强度下转向可能漂移的程度。一次计算覆盖的范围超过了任何测试活动所能驾驶的：在城市干道上，它涵盖133个姿态，若每种强度各测10次则将达到10^133种组合，而该计算在一块GPU上几分钟内即可完成。形式化验证不仅在没有仿真测试的情况下发现了能打破清晰条件训练策略的条件，还提供了一些初步的……
tldr: 该论文提出利用边界传播这一形式化验证方法，仅读取训练好的模型权重，无需额外驾驶或仿真测试，即可在数分钟内证明端到端转向网络在两个测试条件之间所有扰动强度下的车道偏离性能，其验证覆盖范围远超传统测试所能达到的规模。
en_tdlr: This paper employs bound propagation, a formal verification method that reads trained network weights, to prove end-to-end steering performance across all disturbance intensities between captured test conditions without additional driving, covering combinatorially infeasible test spaces (e.g., 10^133 combinations) in minutes on a single GPU.
